scope: Two Ways In, recognizable near-frontal particle brain, preserved desktop/mobile scroll-card handoff and focused career destinations.
punctuation: No em dashes in career copy.

brain.method: Area-weighted barycentric sampling of the actual cortex, visibility-filtered in the reference-facing bilateral pose, with interpolated normals. Centered and uniformly scaled with one rigid orientation transform. No ellipsoid approximation.

pose.description: Near frontal, slight downward view, both hemispheres and central fissure visible.

depthMesh.purpose: Original cortex geometry for invisible depth occlusion only.

inspected: Desktop frontal brain and both reading holds
Desktop shared visual crossing with rising incoming text
Mobile midpoint and reversible horizontal card exchange
visualReview.outcome: Both hemispheres, central fissure and cortical folds are visible. Existing teal, blue, mint and ivory regions are retained. No unrelated floating triangles remain at the reading holds.

coverageLimits: Chrome desktop and viewport/touch emulation, not real-device Safari frame-rate certification.
Reference motion grammar recreated from the recording; original source easing and geometry were not supplied.
